notes.title: Delay of Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Naroot.



We sincerely apologize to announce that the release schedule for Poly TD has been changed.



The new release date is now scheduled for Q4 2025. This change was made so we can shift from an Early Access model to a full release.



We will do our best to deliver a game with richer content and deeper gameplay, worthy of your anticipation.



Once again, we deeply apologize for the delay.

notes.title: Demo Update - 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Poly TD Demo 0.1.0 Update


Hello, players.

It’s been a while. Thank you to everyone who has been waiting. We’re pleased to announce the 0.1.0 demo update.
Poly TD is still actively in development, and we will continue improving it toward a more complete experience.


Content
Added new stage: “Underground Dungeon”

Added new difficulty: “Hard”


Balance
Adjusted HP, Armor, and Magic Resist stats of enemies in Normal difficulty

Increased stat values provided by equipment items


Convenience
Game speed adjustment feature

Pause feature

Hotkeys for combining and selling heroes

Hotkey for selling items

Hotkeys for shop and combination info

Removed shop summon animation

Display of enemy HP, Armor, and Magic Resist


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where items couldn’t be clicked when overlapping with the shop

Fixed a bug where some enemies' HP was not visible


Looking Ahead
Your feedback is a great help in improving the game.
We will continue to work steadily toward completion.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 0.0.3
notes.notes:
We have reviewed all of your valuable feedback and bug reports, and we are continuously improving Poly TD to make it an even more enjoyable game. Thank you so much for playing the demo!

Changes
Balancing
- Fixed an issue where players could obtain more than 2 golden keys.
- Siegfried buffed.
- Shiva nerf:
  - Reduced attack speed and attack power.
- Minerva nerf:
  - Reduced attack power and summon attack power.
- Napoleon summon range reduced.
- 20-wave boss (Zombie Princess) health reduced.

Quality of Life
- Added a feature to collect lower-tier units (unlocked at wave 25).
- Adjusted the position of the sell area.

Bugs
- Attempts to fix the occasional game freeze have been made. However, we are still monitoring it to ensure it's fully resolved. We will continue to monitor the issue to identify the root cause and make improvements.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 0.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the developer of Poly TD.

Thank you for playing the demo.
If you find any issues or have suggestions for improvement, please send feedback through the in-game feedback system or leave a comment on the Steam discussion page or community. We always welcome your feedback.

We are committed to improving the game based on your valuable opinions.
Currently, we are working on bug fixes and implementing feedback-based improvements, and we will continue updating the game to provide a smoother gameplay experience.

Patch Notes - 0.0.2

 Fixed a bug where the game would end after defeating a boss and continuing with bounty hunting
 Adjusted the failure rate of the gacha system
 Adjusted the volume of the tutorial video
 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze during gacha pulls in the shop
